### URL Pattern

- `/2/people/view/{person_id}/call` — the `/call` suffix opens the person record in call-logging context (activates the Log Call action or triggers the FUB dialer)

### Tracking Pixel Pattern

Campaign emails include tracking pixel URLs of the form:
`https://ryan-realty.com/?_pxl=djoxLGM6OTRlMjE3MzYzOTM4NjUsYTox`

The `_pxl` query param encodes (base64-like) the tracking context (campaign ID, contact ID, send ID). "2 open" means the pixel fired twice.

### Non-Obvious Implementation Notes

1. **URL `/call` suffix:** Opening a person record with `/call` appended triggers the dialer or call-log UI in the center column. Other suffixes likely include `/email`, `/text`, `/note` for opening that respective composer. Implement as an optional `initialAction` route param that auto-focuses the relevant quick-action tab.

2. **"Person N of 9" paginator:** This requires the parent list/smart-list context to be maintained in state across navigation. When the user arrived from a list page (People list, smart list, inbox), the ordered result set (person IDs) is passed and stored in session/URL state. Arrow navigation increments/decrements the index and pushes a new URL (`/people/view/{nextId}/`). The keyboard `→`/`←` hint confirms this is keyboard-navigable.

3. **"Assigned to" dropdown with PONDS and TEAM MEMBERS sections:** The dropdown is structured as a grouped multi-section select. "PONDS" are lead-routing pools that distribute to multiple agents; "TEAM MEMBERS" are direct agent assignments. "Me" shortcuts to the logged-in user. Selecting a Pond assigns via round-robin logic server-side. Inline edit mode is activated by clicking the field value; the green ✓ / red ✗ buttons are shown while in edit mode.

4. **Campaign enrollment display:** "Out Of State Home Owners \| 4 more" suggests the field shows one enrollment name with a count badge for overflow. Clicking "4 more" should expand or open a popover listing all 5 campaigns. This is a read-only display field; campaign enrollment happens separately (from campaigns module or via automation).

5. **Timeline event "archived" status:** These automated campaign emails show status "archived" which in email context likely means the lead's email client auto-archived the message, OR the FUB tracking system marks it as "archived" if a certain condition is met (e.g., the person did not reply). "2 open" indicates the tracking pixel was fired twice, meaning the recipient opened the email 2 times.

6. **Automation "Running" with pause button:** Each automation enrollment shows a row-level pause control (‖). Clicking transitions the automation to "Paused" state. The automation itself ("Web Inquiry Option 01") is a named sequence template; the enrollment stores (person_id, automation_id, started_at, status, current_step).

7. **FUB Texting "warming up" notice:** This is a one-time notice shown when a FUB local phone number has been provisioned but SMS sending hasn't been activated yet (requires carrier warm-up period). The "Try out texting" button leads to an onboarding flow. This notice should be dismissible and shown only when `account.texting_status === 'warming_up'`.

8. **AgentFire FUB Widget:** This is a third-party integration widget that renders inside a sidebar section. It appears collapsed by default. Implementation: render an iframe or embedded component in a collapsible `<SidebarSection>`; the widget communicates via a registered FUB integration.

9. **Task overdue styling:** The due date is rendered in red when `task.due_at < now()` and task is still open. The task list in the sidebar shows tasks regardless of overdue status. Filtering/sorting by due date with overdue highlighting is a core requirement.

10. **Email body in timeline:** The "Your home value" email shows a full preview with substantial body text visible. This suggests the timeline renders emails with inline expanded body (not collapsed by default), or with a generous preview character limit (~500+ chars). Emails with attachments show a 📎 icon next to the sender/recipient line.

11. **Recipient "ryan-realty@followupboss.me":** This is the BCC/forwarding address that FUB uses to log emails sent from external mail clients (Gmail, Outlook) into the FUB timeline. Emails BCC'd to this address are parsed and filed under the matching contact.

12. **`_pxl` tracking parameter pattern:** Each campaign email's archived body shows the tracking pixel URL: `https://ryan-realty.com/?_pxl={encoded_tracking_id}`. The `_pxl` value appears to be base64 or a custom encoding of `(campaign_send_id, contact_id, etc.)`. The website's landing page must handle this parameter, fire a callback to FUB (or Pixel Cafe / FUB pixel), and then redirect to the actual page content.

13. **Getting Started bar:** This is an account-level onboarding tracker, not per-contact. It should only render for accounts that have not completed onboarding. Use `account.onboarding_complete` flag to conditionally show. The bar is fixed to the bottom of the viewport and reduces the available scroll area for all three columns.
